name: handle-do-file-missing-exception
description: handle's matching branch names a do file that does not exist, reporting the read failure as an "Exception: " detail rather than a caller-crafted "not found" message, since the do-block resolution has no try/catch of its own on either side
yaml:
appId: com.test
name: handle missing do file
---
- launchApp
- handle:
    - when:
        visible: X
      do: "{{DIR}}/missing-handle-do.yml"
